en: Is that the end already? I had hoped to be of some use.
Ort! How goes the campaign?
I shall redouble my efforts. If there is anything I can do for you, please do not leave it unsaid.
Then I shall go and see for myself what has become of my ruined homeland. Farewell.
Ora noct! You win.
It's all I have left!
Orid katch.
Think you that I am a dog, to come at your command?
You had only to ask in the first place! Pray that misunderstandings like this be not common between us.
Hmph. Fine.
Very well. I shall follow where you lead.
I am a... remnant, a relic. My time was long ago, and yet here I stand. How long has it been? A hundred years? A thousand? Men such as I were not meant to step so through time.
What am I to do now?
You would have me? I may know nothing of the current state of the world, but my arm is still strong.
I am a captain of a long-dead army. What place is there for me in this world?

If I may have a word?

It is strange for me to work in such an unstructured group. 

Everyone manages to hold it together and look out for one another, but my rank means little. 

Don't think I'm complaining, of course! 

It's difficult to describe exactly how I feel, but my whole world has been turned upside down, so it almost feels proper, like just one more thing to have been left behind.

|I've been thinking about what I would have done, if I had been released from that curse before you arrived, if I woke up in that place alone. 

I am no stranger to confusion now, of course, but I can only imagine how much worse it would have been. I might very well have fallen upon my own blade in desperation. I still think about doing it sometimes, but then seeing everything you've built stops me. 

You've given an old relic some direction, and a glimpse of clarity in a world that isn't meant for me. 

For that, I thank you. 

|This is something the Queen gave to me long ago. 

It isn't really worth anything, and it isn't even gold. No more than a trinket, I suppose, but it was a symbol of my duty to her. 

Now that that duty has been fulfilled, I have no need of it, and I offer it to you instead, as a token of my loyalty. 

Where you lead, Beauregard will follow. This, I promise.

Some of the others have taken to calling me "Captain". At first, I thought they were mocking me, but I have begun to feel comforted by it. It is familiar, and familiarity is a rare treat for me. In any case, was there something you needed, or did you just come to hear me complain?
You have no further need of me? I am saddened to hear it.
Ort, friend! How can I serve you?
It is cruel of you to toy with me like this. Either you need me or you do not. Best decide for certain.
I am not sure what to do, but... I won't argue with you. Just let me gather some supplies and I'll be gone.

If you want me to improve your weapons, bring me two pieces. I'll combine the best bits of both to make something even better. Identical pieces usually work best, but sometimes I can make different ones work. Try it and see, I guess!
Something I can do for you?
Back to work then. Take care.
Gimme a break.
Come on, really?
Over there.
What's that?
Well, shit.
That's not good.
Did you hear that?
Nothing, sorry.
Ah shit. Here it comes, everyone.
Been nice knowin' ya.
Just put your back into it.
Are we lookin' at the same guys? We can do this.
Shut up, you're throwing me off!
If that's how you feel, why don't you just run?
Whoops.
Oh. That's ugly.
I thought people were going to give me a hard time for being a goblin and all, but it hasn't been an issue. I guess nobody here is in much of a position to be picky about their bedfellows.
That's it then? My debt's repaid?
Hello. Everything going well?
Well, if you say so.
Well, thanks for the grub and stuff, and good luck with whatever it is you decide to do. I'm out.
You sadistic fuck.
Why would you give it back to me just to beat me up and take it again? Just kill me!
Save me and then doom me to die anyway? At least I won't remember this.
What, you want to make me your pet? Bite me!
I am too weak to resist.
Screw you.
Alright, well, I think I can walk now. Let's go.
I really should have been more careful in there. I'm glad you had better luck than I did. I don't even want to know what it was that grabbed me, I'm just happy to have made it out alive.
I will rest here for a while until my strength has returned in full. Don't let me get in your way.
You want me to come along? I... well I don't see why not, I suppose. I do owe you, after all.
Well it's good of you not to keep me on the hook. Thank you again.

Hey boss. Sorry to bug you."

Borfalgor sits down in front of the fire, and thumbs the amulet around his neck idly.

"I was talking to some of the others. 

Everyone has their secrets, right? Them marks you all got on your necks, I mean. 

I can't read 'em, but I heard someone say they mean something. Labels for things you did, or things someone says you did, right?

Goblins, they don't do anything so complicated. If someone does something bad, they bash his skull in with a rock and be done with it.

|I say "they" instead of "we", you might've noticed. 

I don't have a lot in common with goblins anymore, and I haven't for a long time. I did once, to be sure, but then this amulet here changed everything.

You remember how when you found me, I couldn't remember why I was at that temple? Well, it was like that when I first ended up with this thing too. 

The amulet makes me smart, see, and when I'm smart, stupid thoughts don't make sense anymore. It's like trying to read scratches when you aren't even sure if they're words at all. 

|What I'm saying is that I don't remember how I got this thing.

Goblins can work some basic magic, sure, but nothing as complicated as a magic amulet, and even if they could, I ain't a mage and goblins don't share. It's probably more likely that someone gave it to me, or that I found it, or stole it. 

Probably that last one. 

I'm just spinning a tale with this of course, but I imagine that I probably brained some poor old hermit and took his shiny necklace.

|Whatever happened, putting this thing on made it impossible for me to live with goblins anymore. 

I could barely speak to them, much less relate to them. 

Since then, there's been no place for me to fit, no place to feel that I belong.

I'm not saying that I belong here necessarily, but I think at least everybody else here also feels like they don't belong, and that's something, ain't it?

|So there it is, anyway. My big secret, or as close to one as I got. 

Maybe I still owe you for the rescue back then, or maybe I don't. I'll leave that up to you, but I'm along for me now, not for you. Let's see where this goes, hmm?"

Borfalgor stands up, his stature surprisingly dignified for such a small creature, and he turns toward you.

"I put something in your chest. Just a little thing I found. I was going to keep it for myself, but... I would rather you have it. As my way of saying thanks.

People have been asking me to do things lately, coming to me and asking me to help them with chores, assigning me fire watches, bringing me on hunting parties. I think it means that they trust me, that they're expecting me to do my part like everybody else. It's a good feeling.
So that's it, huh? I ain't in a hurry to leave, but if you're done with me, I'll go.
There you are. Did you need anything?
Sure thing. Don't be in a hurry though, okay? I'm in no rush to leave.
Then I'll go. Thank you for everything, and thanks for giving me the chance to repay you.
God is my shield!
Put the heathens to rout!
There. See that?
Look.
God, guide the fallen.
Meet holy vengeance, cur!
Stand ready.
Nothing here.
If I should die, God take me!
Live or die, God is with us!
Have faith, and the day is ours!
God will guide us!
Such is the lot of a sinner!
Perhaps God will show you mercy!
See what your sins have wrought!
Ask God to forgive you!

It really is quite remarkable to see people working together like this, especially in a place as ill-clouded as Lukatt. When I came here, I knew that I was likely to be walking alongside criminals, but I hadn't expected them to be so civil. I continue to learn new things each day.
You no longer wish to have me along?
Hail. Did you need something?
Ah, just considering your options then? Let me know if aught changes.
Then, I shall continue my pilgrimage alone. Farewell.
With God beside me, I am not afraid!
This is a holy relic, and shall not fall into the hands of one such as you!
I have no choice, it seems.
God is my only Lord and master!
It... is better I should swallow my pride and survive to do God's will. Very well.
I... am bound to accept your mercy.
Then let us begone from this place. I cannot bear to look at it any longer.

Had I truly grown so hardened that I forgot to look for the decency in people? The sisters were nothing but kind and welcoming to me, but I held them to be in contempt of god because of soaps and poetry. I can scarcely imagine something more foolish.
Forgive me, I have nothing to offer you in return for your help. My armour and equipment are valuable, but as an agent of the church, they are not mine to offer.
In truth, I have no destination in particular, and you have been a greater help to me than you may know. It would be my honour to travel with you, for a time at least.
That is hardly surprising. I cannot imagine you would long tolerate the eyes of a crusader upon your back.

May we speak? I awoke for my watch early, and could use the company. Besides, I wanted to discuss something.

I know I have mentioned that I came here on pilgrimage, as a test of my faith to my order, but what I never mentioned was that my decision was... influenced. 

The Crusaders have a purpose, a holy duty, to seek out evil and blasphemy and scourge it where we find it. It's the oath that I, and all Crusaders swear upon our appointment.

|I have been a Crusader for many years, and during that time, I did my duty faithfully and well, but there were some in the order who were... shall we say "dissatisfied" with my devotion.  

They said I was lax, that I was letting a soft heart sweeten my righteous purpose. The smith with whom I shared my breakfast in the morning was a sinner, the moments spent watching children run through the streets were indulgent, the flower I wore to honour a dead grandmother was vain, my stature was prideful. It never ended. 

One day I overheard the deacon talking with another crusader about me. I heard them saying that I was too well-liked by the people, and that I was dulling peoples' respect for the Crusaders as an order. Maybe they were even right. 

|What I heard next though, shocked me. They began to discuss setting me up for a murder, to publicly shame me and have me removed. 

I was furious, but they were both higher-ranking Crusaders than I, and I already well-outranked any town militia who would normally cover such things. There was nobody I could go to, no way to uncover their plot. 

I try to be a virtuous woman, but I am no paragon of cleverness. I couldn't think of anything else to do, so shortly afterward, I declared myself on holy pilgrimage, and the deacon, deliriously pleased with himself, sanctioned my pilgrimage, and named my destination Lukatt. 

|When I arrived, I wandered for a time with what scant supplies I had brought, and then eventually found my way to the Stillwind Abbey, where I very nearly flagellated all of those poor sisters over their love of handmade soaps and the storage of their foodstuff.

I realize now that I was angry. Angry at having been forced into this situation, and angry that I could do nothing to prevent it. Angry that my betters were the very villains I swore to oust, and angry that I abandoned my community to their rule. 

Though I have the motions very well-practiced, my faith was shaken to its very core, and perhaps, in some ways, it still is. Maybe it always will be. 

|I do not regret any of this, however.

If my faith was broken, it was only so I could pick out the pieces that should never have been there, and it is no small irony that I am finding peace and growth in the company of criminals. 

I am coming to know that I must be whole myself before I can hold the authority to judge others, and that knowledge has been most liberating. 

|Forgive me for prattling on so long. I'm sure you're eager to get to your bedroll. 

Only, have a look in your stash when you get an opportunity. It's no treasure to be sure, but I've left something there for you, as a token of my thanks. 

Goodnight.

This armour is heavier than it looks, you know, but lately it feels lighter. I don't know for certain why. Perhaps I've grown stronger, or perhaps something else has grown lighter. Coming to Lukatt was guaranteed to be interesting, but I hadn't expected it to be quite so enlightening.
All things must end, I suppose.
It is good to see you. Is there something I can do for you?
I will continue to assist you then, as long as I am able.
I have much more to learn, and many miles more to walk. It was a privelege to walk some of them by your side. Farewell and Godbless.
Many secrets here, yes. You give me gold and I will help you find them. No lock will be safe!
You need something opened?
Show me what you find.
Good. I'm hungry.
This'll be fun.
You wanna fuck with that?
That important?
Well that bites.
Ya coulda done better.
What are ya lookin' at?
I see nothin'.
Oh shit. Should we run?
This is gonna be shitty.
Nah, that's dumb. Just watch.
Yer not that bad. Just fight.
If I prove ya wrong, ya owe me a drink.
Ya think? Well I think yer stupid.
Yer own fault.
Ya think I suck? You suck.
Ain't got a whole lot to say at the moment. Let's just move along, hmm?
Aww, what's the matter? Am I makin' ya nervous?
How we doin'?
Ya shouldn't let me get under yer skin. Yer better than that, ain't ya?
Well, see if I fuckin' care.
Hey, all this ain't really necessary, is it?
Blah blah blah, if yer gonna kill me, get it over with!
Fer this? Take it, and fuck off!
What, and be yer bitch too? I had enough of bein' everyone's bitch!
Right, ya got me. Byrne the bitch. Fuck.
Right.
Perfect.
The estate's a way off yet, of course. Bit of a hike, you see, but if yer ready to go, we'll be off.
So, ya ready to go and see the magnificent Frico?
Perfect, I'll show ya the way.
Fine. I ain't goin' nowhere.

I can hear 'em, ya know."

Byrne sits down in front of the fire, the bloody red of his eyes glinting in the light. 

"Yer hearts, I mean. All of 'em. 

At first it was maddening, like they're all taunting me. I guess 'cuz I was mad. 

Goddamn Frico. 

|I got sent out here what... five, six years ago, maybe. 

Frico sprung me from the stocks back then. 

He was my hero at first, but, once he turned me, I was just a bitch to him. 

Just one more puppet to do his dirty work. 

I don't so much mind the vampire thing, really. A guy gets used to it. But, since Frico was the one who changed me, he had this kinda power over me.

|Saw him use it on another uppity sucker once, and it weren't pretty. Boiled him alive in his own skin. 

What a mess. 

I sure never would've been able to take him down on my own.

When I found ya, I was... gathering meat for him, and I hated it. 

Not for any special love for you, of course, just because I hated everything he wanted.

|He's dead now though, and I'm free as can be. 

Feels good.

All them beatin' hearts, sounds like frogs singing in the swamp to me now. 

It's the kinda song a fella could get used to."

Byrne turns toward you as a relaxed smile creeps across his lips.

"Ya set me free, so I'm with ya. Just say the word.

Ya know, I spent such a long time itching to get out from under Frico's thumb, so much time hating all of the stuff I didn't want to do, I never really thought about what I do want. I guess I'll have lots of time to figure it out.
Ya don't need me? That's fine, I guess, as long as yer sure.
It's a fuckin' beautiful day.
Then I don't mind stickin' around.
Then I'll go. Thanks fer everything.
You're gonna have a bad time.
Follow my lead, lads!
Look there.
What's that, then?
Damn!
You'll regret that!
Aye?
Nothin'
To the last man!
Stand fast and give 'em hell!
Don't be daft!
Let me show you how it's done!

If you aren't gonna fight, 
get out of the way!
We've no use for yellow bellies!
Push! We can still win!
Fuck it!

I never mentioned this before, but this is quite a neat operation you've got here. Hell, you put together twenty people when I asked you to, and I think you could put together a lot more than that. Gives an old mind new things to think about.
What? You're joking.
Anything to report?
I'm not going to try to take over your crew, you know. Just relax.
You're not joking. Well, I'll just hunt down the Sud'umKatch on my own. Good luck.
There's a way to defeat it. There has to be. We'll figure it out.

And here I thought this was just an issue of the sea keeping us here. I never stopped to wonder why it was this island and not another one. We're sitting on top of a god damn Sud'umKatch. Of course we are. Why wouldn't we be? How did nobody know about this?
There are some basic supplies here, but nothing really worth lugging around, I think.
I'm anxious to leave. Been holed up here for too long.
I'll wait here until you've cleared a spot for me then. This is as good a place to wait as any.
